messages:
marcus: Nora from NovaEdge reached out: they'd like a focused perf/W and kernel-tuning handshake on their new NovaPU boards. Can we scope quick plan and what we need from them?
nora_partner: We can provide 5 boards, calibrated external shunt harnesses, and a kernel engineer for the first 3 days. Prefer Redwood to lead canonical runs; we'll mirror them.
anya: Ok, instrumentation checklist: external shunt logs (1Hz min), perf counters (instr/cycles/cache-miss), kernel debugfs toggles, and thermal sensor sampling. Want calibration CSV up front.
li: Runtime items: enumerate workloads (OPT-175M, Llama2-13B gen), batch sweep 1/4/8, seq lens 128/512/1024, and a KV-heavy long-seq pass. Document driver modes (stock, tuned).
sofia: I'll prepare acceptance thresholds draft: target perf/W uplift >5% vs baseline for tuned driver, and no >5% regression in p99 latency. Also include thermal-run gating.
kevin: Marketplace note: co-marketing possible if we hit targets, but need 7 business days for review and legal on logos. We'll need an embargo schedule.
bench-bot: bench job created -> bench-1757772468-001, results path s3://redwood-partner/novaedge/bench-1757772468-001.
marcus: Action items: 1) Nora to upload calibration and driver images; 2) Anya list perf counters + sampling rates; 3) Li produce bench config and presigned S3; 4) Sofia write acceptance matrix. I'll set a 30m kickoff tomorrow 11:00 PT.
nora_partner: Upload ETA today EOD. Driver engineer (jin) will join kickoff. Embargo ok.
li: Quick rule: warmup 2 minutes, then steady 20 minutes for perf/W sample, ignore first 30s of steady window. Report avg power, tokens/sec, perf/W, p50/p90/p99 latency, and throttling flags.
sofia: Adding telemetry tags: run_id, runtime_sha, kernel_sha, driver_mode, board_serial, power_calib_sha, ambient_C.
marcus: Thanks all. If anything blocks lab or thermal chamber access ping me. :thumbsup:
